title: Radio Disturbance Characteristics for Protection of Receivers used on Board Vehicles, Boats and Internal Combustion Engines - Limits and Methods of Measurement
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 15040) covers Radio Disturbance Characteristics for Protection of Receivers used on Board Vehicles, Boats and Internal Combustion Engines - Limits and Methods of Measurement. This Indian Standard (First Revision) which is identical with CISPR 25 : 2008 'Vehicles, boats and internal combustion engines — Radio disturbance characteristics — Limits and methods of measurement for the protection of on-board receivers' issued by the International Electrotechnical Commission (lEC) was adopted by the Committee and approval of the Electronics and Information Technology Division Council. This standard was originally published in 2001 and was identical to CISPR 25 : 1 995. Thereafter, lEC revised it in the year 2002 and 2008. This revision is, therefore, being undertaken to align it with latest CISPR Standard. This standard is designed to protect on-board receivers from disturbances produced by conducted and radiated emission arising in a vehicle. The limits for electromagnetic interference were earlier covered in 'Limits for electromagnetic interference — Specification (second revision)' which has since been withdrawn. The text of lEC (CISPR) Standard has been approve

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
